create.name: Monroe Institute
create.bio:
The Monroe Institute is a non-profit centre for the exploration of consciousness, established in 1971 by the broadcasting businessman Robert A. Monroe, whose own out-of-body experiences led him to research how sound could guide people into expanded states of awareness. Its method rests on what it now calls Monroe Sound Science, layered binaural audio that encourages the brain into particular states, combined with guided imagery and group work, and it describes no belief requirement beyond an open mind and a sense that life extends beyond the physical.

The home campus covers several hundred acres in the Blue Ridge foothills of Nelson County, Virginia, with two retreat houses, walking paths, a labyrinth and a lake. Its best-known residential programme is the Gateway Voyage, a week-long introduction that leads on to advanced courses on themes such as guidance, intuition and the states beyond death, and there is an EEG-monitored research programme called Discovery. Programmes also run at partner venues in the United States and abroad, and certified trainers lead weekend workshops worldwide. For home practice it offers an online version of Gateway, a meditation app, free audio meditations and a podcast, and it works with researchers on studies of altered states.

courses.title: Gateway Voyage
courses.description: The institute's foundational residential programme: six nights of guided audio exercises, group sharing and talks that introduce expanded states of awareness and the non-physical. It is the gateway to most of the advanced courses and runs on the Virginia campus and at partner venues.

courses.title: Gateway Voyage Online
courses.description: A self-paced online version of Gateway taken over eight to twelve weeks, with exercises narrated by Robert Monroe himself. It can be started at any time from home.

courses.title: Discovery
courses.description: A residential research programme in which participants' brainwaves are recorded by EEG while they work with the institute's audio exercises, so that changes in state can be observed as they happen.

courses.title: Exploring Consciousness
courses.description: A regional weekend workshop led by certified Monroe trainers in many countries, offering a first taste of the institute's methods closer to home.

free_resources.title: Free Meditations
free_resources.description: A library of free audio journeys from the institute, from ambient soundscapes to guided pieces on contemplation, gratitude and lucid dreaming.

free_resources.title: Lucid Dream
free_resources.description: A free audio piece from the institute's collection for exploring dreaming in an expanded state of awareness.

free_resources.title: Expanding on Consciousness Podcast
free_resources.description: The institute's podcast of conversations about consciousness, out-of-body experience and its programmes.
